summary: A 24-year-old male fell ~40 ft while hiking the Red Rock Loop Trail north of Settler's Park west of Boulder and sustained a head injury; BCSO, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Boulder Rural Fire, Four Mile Fire and Pridemark Paramedics responded ~9:30 p.m.; he was found conscious and breathing and transported to Boulder Community Hospital
location: Red Rock Loop Trail, north of Settler's Park, west of Boulder
responding_agency: Boulder County Sheriff's Office (with Rocky Mountain Rescue Group)
